messages:
Alex: Heads-up — seeing a sudden spike in 5xx and gateway timeouts for hosted inference across eu-west-1. Error rate went from ~0.7% to ~11% in the last 6m. A lot of 502/504s and some 5xx from the router layer.

incident-bot: Alert: HTTP 5xx rate exceeded threshold (11%) for /v1/generate (eu-west-1). Pager: oncall. Severity: high.

oncall-bot: Paged maya as primary oncall and jamie as backup.

sre-jamie: I'm looking. Can someone paste the tail of the gateway logs and a few example request IDs? Also, any recent config changes to prefix or prefetch?

Alex: Quick log snippet:
```
2026-03-15T18:12:03Z router[e7fd]: req=abcd1234 status=502 upstream=kv-prefix-p7 timeout=1.2s err="kv read failure: checksum mismatch"
2026-03-15T18:12:05Z router[e7fd]: req=abcd5678 status=504 upstream=kv-prefix-p7 err="eviction backpressure"
2026-03-15T18:12:12Z cache[p7]: eviction_rate=842/s miss_rate=0.78 prefix_hits=0.12 checksum_errors=17
```

eng-runtime: We're seeing an eviction storm on prefix shard p7 (hot key churn). The prefix cache miss ratio spiked to 78% and checksum_errors jumped — looks like partial corruption during concurrent compaction. No deploys in last 2 hours.

Maya: Taking pager. Quick action plan: 1) Route affected traffic to fallback routing tier (model-standby) to stop user-facing 5xx flow. 2) Temporarily disable prefix prefetch/warm on p7 range. 3) Enable cache-bypass header for 1% of traffic to validate origin stability. 4) Kick off kv checksum scrub job on p7.

sre-jamie: To route fallback now:
```
# roll routing to standby for eu-west-1 prefixes p7 range
redwoodctl routing update --region eu-west-1 --prefix-range p7 --fallback-tier standby --reason "eviction+checksum spike"
```

eng-runtime: Also toggling prefetch:
```
redwoodctl cache-config set --shard p7 --prefetch enabled=false --ttl 60s
```

Alex: Ran a quick curl test with cache bypass header 
```
curl -H "X-Cache-Bypass: true" -sS -D - https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate | head -n 20
```
Result: requests without cache-bypass still 502/504; requests with bypass returned 200 and model payload in ~320ms. So origin model nodes are healthy; problem isolated to prefix cache path.

customer-support: Two customer tickets flagged major errors: TKT-1829 and TKT-1830 (both eu-west). They reported request failures and longer latencies starting ~18:10 UTC. Notified customers we are investigating.

Maya: After routing to standby and disabling prefetch, 5xx rate dropped from 11% -> 2.3% over 8 minutes. Still seeing occasional 502s tied to p7. Starting kv checksum scrub now (low-priority scrub job with throttling).

eng-runtime: KVS scrub job kicked off. Monitoring checksum_errors metric. If scrub doesn't reduce errors in 30m, we'll escalate to shard-level rebuild and coordinate capacity.

sre-jamie: Also deployed temporary circuit-breaker to throttle fanout for long tail keys to avoid further eviction amplification. Command we used: 
```
redwoodctl circuit create --name eviction-throttle-p7 --shard p7 --threshold 200rps --action throttle
```

Alex: Observed impact: error rate plateaued at ~0.8% after throttle + fallback, but latency for some routed requests increased ~150ms due to standby path. Customer errors are substantially reduced.

Maya: Handing off to eng-runtime for sustained fix and postmortem. Summary for handoff:
- Root cause: eviction storm + concurrent compaction leading to checksum errors on prefix shard p7, causing KV read failures and gateway 5xx.
- Actions taken: fallback routing to standby; disabled prefetch on p7; enabled cache-bypass for validation; kicked off checksum scrub; created eviction throttle circuit; notified customers.
- Impact: Peak ~11% 5xx for eu-west, ~1200 failed requests/min at peak, two enterprise tickets opened.
- Next steps for eng-runtime: complete scrub, verify shard integrity, decide on rebuild vs. repair, follow-up postmortem with remediation (atomic compaction + backpressure fix).

eng-runtime: Acknowledged takeover. Will run deeper diagnostics and report every 30m in this thread. Created internal task: ENG-4521 (prefix-shard p7 integrity & compaction audit).

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged by maya; status: mitigated. Pager unpaged.

Maya: Thanks team. I'll update the oncall notes and open a postmortem draft with timelines and customer impact. Assigning eng-runtime and jamie to the follow-up. :thumbsup:

sre-jamie: Recommend scrubbing checksums for adjacent shards too, and adding an alert for checksum_errors > 5 over 5m. I'll own the alerting change.

customer-support: We'll follow up with customers with a timeline and mitigation summary. Please add any ETA to the ENG-4521 task.

Alex: Good work. Marking incident as mitigated for now. Postmortem and SLA impact calc to follow.

incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated) at 2026-03-15T18:34:38Z.
